# Flavor Isle

> Flavor Isle is a family-owned burger and shake diner at 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY 42171, about 0.7 miles off I-65 Exit 38. Serving since 1964. Hand-patted burgers, fresh-cut fries and thick shakes, eaten at the counter, in the dining room or from the walk-up window. About 100 items on the live menu, including 15 burgers and more than 30 shake and soft-serve builds. Order online, by phone or at the counter for pickup, curbside, dine-in or the walk-up window; delivery covers a 5-mile radius around Smiths Grove when a driver is on shift.

## Key facts

- Name: Flavor Isle
- Address: 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY 42171
- Highway: 0.7 miles from I-65 Exit 38, about 15 minutes north of Bowling Green
- Hours: Monday-Saturday 10:30 AM - 7:00 PM; Sunday 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM; kitchen closes 30 minutes before close (store local time, Central)
- Diner phone: (270) 563-4618
- Phone ordering and texting (Smashie, the AI ordering line): (270) 563-7230
- Order online: https://flavor-isle.com/menu
- Fulfillment: pickup, curbside, dine-in and the walk-up window every day. Delivery runs inside a 5-mile radius when a driver is on shift (free within 3 miles, $1.99 from 3 to 5 miles); the ordering page always shows whether delivery is open today.
- Menu size: about 98 items on the live menu across 15 categories
- Price range: $1.13–$11.50
- Payment: card online and at the counter, cash accepted
- Happy hour: 2:00-6:00 PM, half off drinks
- Serves: burgers (single, double, bacon, mushroom Swiss, minis, melts, Backyard BBQ), chicken, hot dogs, fries, curly fries, tots, onion rings, thick shakes and soft serve, combos and drinks
- Family-owned since 1964.
- Museum: National Corvette Museum about 15 minutes away
- Parking: easy parking near the diner, room for trucks and trailers

## Menu variety

The live menu is not a short burger-and-fries list — it is about 98 items:

- 15 burgers: hamburger, cheeseburger, double hamburger, double cheeseburger, bacon and double bacon versions, mushroom Swiss (single and double), mini burgers and minis, cheeseburger melts, Backyard BBQ, hamburger steak
- Chicken: tenders and chicken sandwiches, plus the handheld lineup
- Hot dogs and frankfurters
- Sides: french fries, hand-cut curly fries, tots, onion rings and loaded sides
- More than 30 shake and dessert builds: thick hand-spun milkshakes, malts, Bliss builds and soft serve, in flavors including banana pudding, caramel, cookies and cream and seasonal specials
- Combo meals, fountain drinks, and half-price drinks during happy hour

The menu syncs with the restaurant's point-of-sale catalog, so an item sold out in the store is hidden online until it is back.

## Wait times and ordering ahead

- Every online checkout shows a live wait estimate, recalculated from how busy the kitchen is, and quoted as a range (never a single minute).
- At normal volume that quote is usually in the 10 to 30 minute band; it climbs when the grill is busy.
- Ordering ahead is the point of the online menu: pay, and the kitchen starts the food before you arrive. Pickup is a short walk in, curbside brings it to the car, and the walk-up window needs no table.
- Scheduled orders can be placed for a later time slot.
- Peak windows are lunch, 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM, and dinner, 5:00 to 7:00 PM. Mid-afternoon between 2:00 and 4:00 PM is the quietest stretch.

## Delivery

- Delivery is part of the service, not a missing feature: it covers a 5-mile radius around Smiths Grove, free within 3 miles and $1.99 from 3 to 5 miles.
- It runs when a driver is on shift. When it is off for the day, the ordering page says so and pickup, curbside, dine-in and the walk-up window stay open.
- Bowling Green is about 15 minutes south, outside the delivery radius, which is why pickup and curbside are the usual choice for Bowling Green customers.

## How far away

- I-65 Exit 38: 0.7 miles
- Mammoth Cave National Park: About 15 minutes to the Mammoth Cave park entrance, and about 25 minutes to the visitor center.
- National Corvette Museum: about 15 minutes

Flavor Isle, 103 N Main St, Smiths Grove, KY — 0.7 miles from I-65 Exit 38.
